{{Attr|Health Regen}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Actor1''', which uses the display name of just '''Actor''', was a summon only enemy in [[The Narratorium]] as part of [[The Final Act Event]]. Originally, it was the first actor that appeared in [[Nil Zone]] as part of the [[Halloween 2025 Live Events]]. It had a decent amount of health and a slightly fast speed for its debut. It can be spawned by the [[Enigma (Nil Zone)|Enigma]], [[Mechanical Rot (Nil Zone)|Mechanical Rot]], [[Producer]] and [[Painter]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Oh my, oh my! This poor actor was written off after their previous performance failed. Then, a "glitch" offered an unexpected opportunity. Time had slowed to a crawl and, in an instant, reversed to a moment before the supposed grand finale. They believed the show was finished, but moments later, their memories began to fade away.''" ==Appearance== The '''Actor1''' has black skin. It wears a brown tunic, gloves and boots, a purple hat, black pants and a black shirt with red diamonds on it. It also wears a white colored sad theater mask. ==Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[The Narratorium]] and [[Nil Zone]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers like the [[Golden Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]] or [[Engineer]] are recommended against this. *As the '''Actor1''' is quite fast and due to its lack of immunities, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]] or [[Freezer]] can be used to slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} Actor1walk.gif|Walking animation (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseActor1.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (4 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} Actor1IconIG.png|'''Actor1''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *This enemy was first used in [[The Great Finale]] as part of the [[Lunar Overture Event]]. ==Update History== *'''4 October 2025''' -
